title: OSS - cheatsheet opens via help menu and drops gated module chips
verifies: the cheatsheet opens from the Help menu and applies edition gating: 12 core module chips render while the 4 fully-gated chips are absent

title: OSS - enterprise/cloud-only pages are hidden within surviving modules
verifies: enterprise/cloud/flag-gated page rows never render while a core page row (logsRunQuery) stays visible

title: toggles via shift+?, close button, and Escape
verifies: shift+? toggles the dialog both ways and the close button and Escape also close it

title: filters rows via search and shows the no-results empty state
verifies: live search narrows rows, non-matching chips drop, and a nonsense query shows the no-results state and removes the chip container

title: clicking a chip scrolls to and highlights its module
verifies: clicking a module chip scrolls to that module and briefly applies the highlight class
